display.title: {"text": "III. Expedition Hall"}
description: &6STATION III&r  Furnish an equipment bench, an archive lectern and a discovery display, then finish two of three regional expeditions.
&eWhy:&r Each region you finish permanently adds its own charts to the station's survey desk.
&7- An equipment bench: smithing table, anvil or grindstone&r
&7- An archive: a lectern or chiseled bookshelf&r
&7- A Discovery Case or any boss trophy on display&r
&eUnlocks:&r Warp scrolls and expedition gear; the survey desk keeps every regional chart you have contributed.
&7Commission it from the charter panel. This quest completes by itself when the station records it.&r
&aDo:&r Commission Expedition Hall at your charter.
&6You get:&r Arcane Conservatory: commission one research room with Ars Nouveau, Iron's Spells or Occultism.
